Snapshot testing has emerged as a low-cost regression testing method that detects unexpected changes by comparing program behavior before and after modifications. arxiv-se.title: Who Verifies the Agent's Success Claim? Self-Report Leakage in GUI-Agent Completion Judging
arxiv-se.excerpt: arXiv:2610.29609v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In automation pipelines, a GUI agent's confident success report can let downstream stages proceed even when the recorded execution trace does not show that the agent produced the requested outcome. We call this case a dangerous misreport: an unhedged success claim that the trace does not support as causal accomplishment during the run. We study report--trace auditing, which checks an agent's completion claim against an independently recorded trace.
